verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS calendar assistant like Reclaim, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Related items such as the #nosync hashtag control calendar syncing, not telemetry, and community privacy objections show no such capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
